dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But... What if someone else tried to pass themselves off as chief?

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: Haha, a few of our young-uns have asked me the same thing. "If you're always wearing a mask, Chief, how would we even know you're not an imposter?"

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: The answer's simple — if you doubt who I am, come face me in the ring.

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: Words can deceive, writing can mislead, but muscles... never lie.
